Build a graph neural network

Source: R/gnn-models.R
gnn_model.Rd

Stacks num_layers message passing layers of one architecture, each followed by an activation, optional normalization and dropout, then adds a prediction head:

Usage

gnn_model(
  architecture = c("sage", "gcn", "gat", "gatv2", "gin", "graph_conv", "transformer",
    "mpnn", "rgcn"),
  input_dim,
  hidden_dim = 64L,
  output_dim = NULL,
  num_layers = 2L,
  dropout = 0.5,
  activation = "relu",
  heads = 4L,
  edge_dim = NULL,
  aggr = NULL,
  pool = NULL,
  norm = c("none", "batch", "layer"),
  residual = FALSE,
  num_relations = NULL,
  num_bases = NULL
)

Arguments

architecture

One of "sage", "gcn", "gat", "gatv2", "gin", "graph_conv", "transformer", "mpnn" (edge conditioned nn_conv()), "rgcn".

input_dim

Node feature size.

hidden_dim

Hidden size. For "gat", "gatv2" and "transformer" it must be divisible by heads.

output_dim

Output size (classes or targets), or NULL.

num_layers

Number of message passing layers.

dropout

Dropout probability after each layer.

activation

Activation name: "relu", "elu", "gelu", "tanh" or "leaky_relu" (slope 0.2).

heads

Attention heads.

edge_dim

Edge feature size ("mpnn", GINE, attention with edge features).

aggr

Neighbor aggregation for "sage", "graph_conv", "mpnn", "rgcn".

pool

NULL, "mean", "sum", "max" or "attention".

norm

"none", "batch" or "layer" normalization after each layer.

residual

Add a residual connection around each layer after the first.

num_relations, num_bases

Relation count and bases for "rgcn".

Value

An nn_module of class graph_model.

Details

  • node level (pool = NULL): a linear layer to output_dim per node;

  • graph level (pool set): global pooling, then an MLP to output_dim per graph;

  • encoder only (output_dim = NULL): returns node embeddings of size hidden_dim, for link prediction or representation learning.

The model's forward(x, edge_index, edge_weight, edge_attr, batch, num_graphs, edge_type) takes tensors from graph_tensors(). Setting return_embedding = TRUE returns the last hidden node representation instead of the head output. The construction arguments are kept in model$config so that save_graph_fit() can rebuild the model.

Examples

if (torch::torch_is_installed()) {
  m <- gnn_model("sage", input_dim = 4, hidden_dim = 8, output_dim = 3)
  x <- torch::torch_randn(5, 4)
  ei <- torch::torch_tensor(rbind(1:4, 2:5), dtype = torch::torch_long())
  m(x, ei)$shape
}
#> [1] 5 3
